Wright Investors Service Cut Position in Pepsico (PEP) by $802,894; Suntrust Banks (STI) Holding Maintained by Ferguson Wellman Capital Management Inc
June 14, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Wright Investors Service Inc decreased its stake in Pepsico Inc (PEP) by 41.49% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wright Investors Service Inc sold 7,366 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.58% with the market. The institutional investor held 10,388 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.13 million, down from 17,754 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wright Investors Service Inc who had been investing in Pepsico Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $148.65B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.41% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $104.84. About 2.19 million shares traded. PepsiCo, Inc. (NYSE:PEP) has declined 14.65% since June 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.22% the S&P500.
